programme.desc: A famous guest spends the night with Olly Wannabe for ten weeks. But there is little sleep in the house... / Tien weken lang blijft een bekende gast slapen bij Olly Wannabe. Maar van slapen komt weinig in huis ...

programme.title: Ninja Express / Ninja Express
programme.desc: Aka, Kiro and Konpeki are three ninjas with fabulous superpowers who, with their special parcel service, can deliver absolutely anything at any time and to any conceivable location. / Aka, Kiro en Konpeki zijn drie ninjas met fabelachtige superkrachten die met hun bijzondere pakketdienst werkelijk alles op elk ogenblik en op elke denkbare locatie kunnen afleveren.

programme.title: Lou / Lou
programme.desc: Animated series about the daily life of the 12-year-old girl Lou, who lives with her single mother and cat in a big city. Based on the comic series of the same name by artist Julien Neel. / Animatieserie over het dagelijkse leven van het 12-jarige meisje Lou, die met haar alleenstaande moeder en kat in een grote stad woont. Gebaseerd op de gelijknamige stripreeks van tekenaar Julien Neel.

programme.title: Dodo / Dodo
programme.sub-title: Blij dat ik het niet ben
programme.desc: Joe is afraid that everyone will think he's a wimp if he admits he's afraid of a Halloween story. / Joe is bang dat iedereen hem watje gaat vinden als hij toegeeft dat hij bang is voor een halloweenverhaal.

programme.title: De Faker / De Faker
programme.desc: At first glance it seems like an ordinary family, but something is not right. One of the family members has been replaced by an actor. But who is that? It is played by: The boys' team: Niek Roozen, Juvat Westendorp and Klaas van der Eerden. The girls' team: Marije Zuurveld, Stephanie van Eer and Shelly Sterk. / Op het oog lijkt het een doodgewoon gezin maar er klopt iets niet. Een van de gezinsleden is vervangen door een acteur. Maar wie dat is? Er wordt gespeeld door: Het jongensteam: Niek Roozen, Juvat Westendorp en Klaas van der Eerden. Het meidenteam: Marije Zuurveld, Stephanie van Eer en Shelly Sterk.

programme.title: Karrewiet With VGT / Karrewiet Met VGT
programme.desc: Information magazine for youth. Interpreted in Flemish Sign Language (VGT). Also available on Ketnet.be, via the KetnetVideo app and via Net Missed. / Infomagazine voor de jeugd. Getolkt in Vlaamse Gebarentaal (VGT). Ook beschikbaar op Ketnet.be, via de KetnetVideo-app en via Net gemist.

programme.title: Hello Kroket / Hallo Kroket
programme.desc: Daily live show in which the KETNET wrappers draw you into the world of KETNET and that of the Ketnetters. Expect famous guests, crazy scoops, fun performances, exciting games and so much more. HELLO CROQUETTE! / Dagelijkse liveshow waarin de KETNET-wrappers je meetrekken in de wereld van KETNET en die van de Ketnetters. Verwacht je aan bekende gasten, zotte primeurs, leuke optredens, spannende spelletjes en nog zo veel meer. HALLO KROKET!

programme.title: #IkLome / #LikeMe
programme.desc: The interview of the Dubois family is in the newspaper. But everyone mainly talks about Caro's highly edited photos. Caro herself doesn't know whether Vince's world is really her thing. Meanwhile, Maria clashes with Scott over Yemi. / Het interview van het gezin Dubois staat in de krant. Maar iedereen praat vooral over de erg bewerkte fotos van Caro. Caro zelf weet niet goed of dat wereldje van Vince echt haar ding is. Ondertussen botst Maria met Scott over Yemi.

programme.title: Girls / Meisjes
programme.desc: Compilation of the video fragments from the web series Girls that were shown this week on Ketnet's online platforms. The series is based on the Norwegian web-only drama series Jenter. / Compilatie van de videofragmenten van de webreeks Meisjes die deze week op de online platformen van Ketnet te zien waren. De reeks is gebaseerd op de Noorse web only dramareeks Jenter.

programme.title: How hard can it be? / Hoe moeilijk kan het zijn?
programme.desc: There are wolves in Belgium again and you see photos and videos everywhere. From wolves on the street, to even chill in the garden! How difficult can it be to spot a wolf? / Er zijn weer wolven in België en overal kom je fotos en filmpjes tegen. Van wolven op straat, tot zelfs chill in de tuin! Hoe moeilijk kan het zijn om een wolf te spotten?

programme.title: The Council of Soekie / De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: Bully Kenji makes the toilet unsafe. Pedro decides that Kenji must be locked up every playtime. Soekie does not agree, but notices that everyone can go back to the toilet and accepts it. Aiko is late for school. Just like Kenji, she has a red backpack. For Pedro, this is proof that every student with a red backpack is a potential criminal. He wants to preventively lock up every student with a red backpack every playtime so that they cannot commit criminal acts. / Bully Kenji maakt de wcs onveilig. Pedro beslist dat Kenji elke speeltijd opgesloten moet worden. Soekie is het er niet mee eens, maar merkt dat iedereen terug naar het toilet kan en legt er zich bij neer. Aiko komt te laat op school. Net zoals Kenji heeft zij een rode rugzak. Voor Pedro is dit het bewijs dat elke leerling met een rode rugzak een potentiële crimineel is. Hij wil elke leerling met een rode rugzak elke speeltijd preventief opsluiten zodat ze geen criminele feiten kunnen plegen.

programme.title: The Hoppers / De Hoppers
programme.desc: Jackie is proud of her homemade rocket, which she has named Rudi. She is ready to take off, but then it turns out that someone has broken Rudi. Jackie is sure there is foul play and wants to know who killed Rudi. She and Esra look for the perpetrator. All Hoppers have a motive and are therefore suspicious. / Jackie is trots op haar zelfgemaakte raket, die ze Rudi heeft genoemd. Ze is klaar om ermee op te stijgen, maar dan blijkt dat iemand Rudi stuk heeft gemaakt. Jackie is er zeker van dat er kwaad opzet in het spel zit en wil weten wie Rudi vermoord heeft. Ze gaat samen met Esra op zoek naar de dader. Alle Hoppers hebben een motief en zijn dus verdacht.

Silke houdt de boot af wanneer Ilias zijn plannen bekendmaakt voor oudjaar. De acties van Eddy halen de nodige ergernissen bij Angèle naar boven.

programme.title: Animal doctors 24/7 / Dierendokters 24/7
programme.desc: Leo is an alpaca. His owners found him sick in the pasture this morning. His condition is visibly deteriorating. It will be an exciting day for heart specialists in large pets. A groundbreaking heart operation is scheduled for a competition horse today. Zyra is a young boxer. While playing with a stick, a splinter punctured one of her salivary glands. / Leo is een alpaca. Zijn eigenaars vonden hem vanmorgen ziek op de weide. Zijn toestand gaat zienderogen achteruit. Voor de hartspecialisten bij grote huisdieren wordt het een spannende dag. Er staat vandaag een baanbrekende hartoperatie gepland bij een wedstrijdpaard. Zyra is een jonge boxer. Bij het spelen met een stok heeft een splinter een van haar speekselklieren doorboord.

programme.title: Hotel Romance / Hotel Romantiek
programme.desc: Gloria, Sven and Philippe organize a kayak trip for the bachelors, giving them time to get to know each other and find a picnic meal. Which couple will emerge from this and get to spend the night at the most romantic location in Poland? / Gloria, Sven en Philippe organiseren voor de vrijgezellen een tocht in een kajak, waarbij ze de tijd hebben om elkaar te leren kennen en een picknickmaaltijd bij elkaar te zoeken. Welk koppel komt daaruit voort en mag de nacht doorbrengen op de meest romantische locatie van Polen?

programme.title: Cops / Flikken
programme.desc: While waiting for Tony's return, Britt certainly doesn't make things easy for her new partner. Commissioner Vanbruane gives Britt another chance. And a new partner. The duo must immediately respond to a traffic accident with a hit-and-run: a young mother has been hit by a heavy car in front of her son. The only witness to the event reacts strangely, the officers think. / In afwachting van Tonys terugkeer maakt Britt het haar nieuwe partner beslist niet gemakkelijk. Commissaris Vanbruane geeft Britt nog een kans. En een nieuwe partner. Het duo moet meteen uitrukken voor een verkeersongeval met vluchtmisdrijf: een jonge moeder is onder de ogen van haar zoontje door een zware wagen aangereden. De enige getuige van de gebeurtenis reageert vreemd, vinden de agenten.

programme.desc: Rosa didn't spend the night at home. Karin thinks she has found a way to keep everyone at Feniks happy. The police station is holding a team building event. Simonne finally feels supported. / Rosa heeft de nacht niet thuis doorgebracht. Karin denkt een manier te hebben gevonden om iedereen bij Feniks gelukkig te houden. Het politiekantoor houdt een teambuilding. Simonne voelt zich eindelijk gesteund.

programme.title: Nothing to see / Niks te zien
programme.desc: Visually impaired Karl Meesters goes to Geilo in cold Norway with Antwerp rapper Prince K. Appiah, not with their eyes but with their ears on edge. They discover that ice is more than frozen water: they look for the magical sounds of a frozen lake, they make their own ice instrument and they breathe Norwegian folk in a hot sauna that ends with, how could it be otherwise, an ice dive. Prince ends the journey with a new song as a memory. / Slechtziende Karl Meesters trekt met Antwerpse rapper Prince K. Appiah naar Geilo in het koude Noorwegen, niet met hun ogen maar met hun oren op scherp. Ze ontdekken er dat ijs meer is dan bevroren water: ze gaan op zoek naar de magische geluiden van een bevroren meer, ze maken hun eigen ijsinstrument en ze ademen Noorse folk in een hete sauna die eindigt met, hoe kan het ook anders, een ijsduik. Prince sluit de reis af met een nieuw nummer als herinnering.

programme.title: Thirtysomethings / Dertigers
programme.desc: Sami and Lies are engaged. The situation has become untenable for Ada. Nele needs help and advice from Marvin. Ruben's message made an impression on Sander. Jonas must decide what he wants now for his future... and that of Laura and Billie. / Sami en Lies zijn verloofd. De situatie is onhoudbaar geworden voor Ada. Nele heeft hulp en advies van Marvin nodig. De boodschap van Ruben heeft indruk gemaakt op Sander. Jonas moet beslissen wat hij nu wil voor zijn toekomst... en die van Laura en Billie.

programme.title: Taking care of mom / Zorgen voor mama
programme.desc: Kristel and Joost get to know 78-year-old Paul at the Luchtbal in Antwerp: for the first time they take a senior with them in a Care for Mom program. Paul spent his life in financial poverty and has also ended up in social poverty: he is lonely and no longer fits in with society. In addition to being a social worker, Deborah is also a therapist and receives An and Tommy for a couple's conversation about their family and relationship. There will be an action plan. Kristel visits Impe in Hasselt, because he has big news! And Fatih goes with him to take steps for his future. / Kristel en Joost leren op de Luchtbal in Antwerpen de 78-jarige Paul kennen: voor het eerst nemen ze een senior mee in traject bij Zorgen voor mama. Paul spendeerde zijn leven in financiële armoede en belandde intussen ook in sociale armoede: hij is eenzaam en vindt geen aansluiting meer in de maatschappij. Deborah is - naast sociaal werker - ook therapeute en ontvangt An en Tommy voor een koppelgesprek over hun gezin en relatie. Er komt een plan van aanpak. Kristel zoekt Impe op in Hasselt, want hij heeft groot nieuws! En Fatih gaat met hem op pad om stappen te zetten voor zijn toekomst.

programme.desc: Olivier has a chance to win a career prize. Caro is allowed to go to the awards ceremony, but not without getting a makeover from Merel and the squad. But not everything goes as expected. Emma takes it upon herself to cheer Caro up. / Olivier maakt kans om een carrièreprijs te winnen. Caro mag mee naar de prijsuitreiking, maar niet zonder een make-over te krijgen van Merel en de squad. Maar niet alles loopt zoals verwacht. Emma neemt het op haar om Caro op te beuren.

programme.title: Girls / Meisjes
programme.desc: Amelie, Cleo, Fleur and Luna are best friends and together they experience all kinds of adventures. The young girls can count on each other's support at school and they also hold their own in the outside world. / Amelie, Cleo, Fleur en Luna zijn beste vriendinnen en samen beleven ze allerlei avonturen. De jonge meiden kunnen op elkaars steun rekenen op school en ook in de buitenwereld staan ze samen hun mannetje.

programme.title: Bernie / Bernie
programme.desc: Funny animated series about the genius inventor Bernie who is lost at the bottom of the ocean. With his clumsy and crazy new neighbors, a return to the island will not be easy! / Grappige animatiereeks over de geniale uitvinder Bernie die verdwaald is op de bodem van de oceaan. Met zijn onhandige en maffe nieuwe buren wordt een terugkeer naar het eiland alvast niet makkelijk!

programme.title: Video clips #likeme season 5 / Videoclips #likeme seizoen 5
programme.desc: Clip #LikeMe from Series 05 Episode 07: #Showtime - Young / Clip #LikeMe van Reeks 05 Aflevering 07: #Showtime - Jong

programme.title: Prank Squad / Prank Squad
programme.desc: The Prank Squad wants to target Ketnet wrapper Sarah. Together with Heritier they prank her with a fart orchestra during recordings. / De Prank Squad wil Ketnet-wrapper Sarah te grazen nemen. Samen met Heritier pranken ze haar met een scheetorkest tijdens opnames.

programme.title: The Council of Soekie / De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: Students whose school has been destroyed come to temporarily attend classes at BROL. This is against the wishes of Pedro who thinks that the BROL is already full. According to him, there is no room for the newcomers and Pedro accuses them of wanting to take over the school and impose their laws. Soekie stands up for the newcomers and refutes Pedro's lies. / Leerlingen wiens school verwoest is, komen tijdelijk les volgen op het BROL. Dit tegen de zin van Pedro die vindt dat het BROL al vol is. Er is volgens hem geen plaats voor de nieuwelingen en Pedro beschuldigt hen dat ze de school willen overnemen en hun wetten opleggen. Soekie komt op voor de nieuwelingen en weerlegt de leugens van Pedro.

programme.title: The Hoppers / De Hoppers
programme.desc: Jackie thinks it's time for Daria and Arno to learn to take care of themselves, in case they ever leave home. She gives the two a challenge. They have to do everything alone for a week, without help from Jackie and Geert. They have to learn to cook, do the laundry, get up on time and clean up. Daria and Arno take up the challenge. Geert hates the idea that his Hoppers will ever leave the nest and does not like the challenge. / Jackie vindt dat het tijd wordt dat Daria en Arno voor zichzelf leren zorgen, voor als ze ooit het huis uit gaan. Ze geeft de twee een challenge. Ze moeten een week lang alles alleen doen, zonder hulp van Jackie en Geert. Ze moeten leren koken, de was doen, op tijd opstaan en opruimen. Daria en Arno gaan de uitdaging aan. Geert vindt het idee dat zijn Hoppertjes ooit het nest zullen verlaten verschrikkelijk en ziet de challenge niet zitten.

programme.title: Shaun The Sheep / Shaun Het Schaap
programme.desc: Animated series about the smart sheep Shaun, who experiences all kinds of adventures on the farm. / Animatieserie over het slimme schaapje Shaun, dat allerlei avonturen beleeft op de boerderij.

programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. In a combination of sincere stories of those who live on their work, through the discovery of the sights and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with the words of hope and inspiration, and with pictures of which the heart is melted, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokic will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are his problems and challenges? What is the strength to work and nurture tradition and good interpersonal relationships? How does our native lump breathe and does she have a flat in her beauty? What do they remember? What are they stunned before? What are they coming back? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell the story, who we do not know how much they carry love, research, courage in themselves, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt the suffering and beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

programme.title: From morning to tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. The two of them except the couple are in the studio, they are for years and private life. However, what the audience doesn't even want, is that their idyll on the screen has nothing to do with what the cameras turn off - the two of them actually live a nightmare. When the Marko director of Television is quitting, to move to competing television, he gets a blow from which he falls into a coma, and the director finds a double, young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play an Oscar brand, and will it work? In addition to being in an interesting way, with many laughs and life situations, their relationship and relationships with colleagues and friends, even to the vortex of the media, will see many secrets, and those business and new love and friendship, and start new avalanches of rivalry. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: Fundus / Fundus
programme.desc: "Fundus" is a TV story format whose themes are BH. Cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of valuable cultural treasure that preserve museums across the country. The best promotion of the state is through its rich and varied culture. Museum depots keep thousands of valuable cases and exhibits, including numerous world rarities. Collections and collections do not even lag behind the settings in reputable European and world museums. This form of BHRT wants to present them to the general public and remind them of their value. The stories are processed only by basic and most interesting details, with the aim of encouraging viewers to visit museums and institutions in which exhibits are found. In the fundus you will see the interesting facts you haven't known so far, the items you haven't seen before, and it will also present part of the tradition on which there is no information recorded. / "Fundus" je format TV priča čije su teme bh. kulturno-historijsko naslijeđe, nepoznate priče i detalji iz naše baštine, ali i podsjećanje na vrijedno kulturno blago koje čuvaju muzeji širom zemlje. Najbolja promocija države je preko njene bogate i raznovrsne kulture. Muzejski depoi čuvaju hiljade vrijednih predmeta i eksponata, među kojima su brojni svjetski rariteti. Kolekcije i zbirke ni po čemu ne zaostaju za postavkama u uglednim evropskim i svjetskim muzejima. Ovom formom BHRT želi da ih predstavi široj javnosti i podsjeti na njihovu vrijednost. Priče obrađuju samo osnovne i najzanimljivije detalje, s ciljem da potaknu gledatelje da za više informacija posjete muzeje i ustanove u kojima se nalaze eksponati. U Fundusu ćete vidjeti zanimljivosti koje do sada niste znali, predmete koje niste prije vidjeli, a predstaviće i dio tradicije o kojoj nema zabilježenih informacija.

programme.title: My country / Moja zemlja
programme.desc: A show dedicated to Bosnia and Herzegovina and us in it, people, lives, destinies, what people live, what they would like to improve, indicate or preserve for some new generations. The land is not (just) space, not just mountains, rivers, valleys, land, above all, are people. The land does not make flags, political pamphlets, the land is made up of ordinary people with everyday lives, joys and sadness ... This and such a country speaks a new series of the BHT1 Information Program, "My Land", which edits and, driving its Oldtimer from the end to the end of the Wonderful Bosnia and Herzegovina, leads Elvir Bucalo. / Emisija posvećena Bosni i Hercegovini i nama u njoj, ljudima, životima, sudbinama, onome što ljudi žive, što bi htjeli popraviti, ukazati ili sačuvati za neke nove generacije. Zemlja nije (samo) prostor, nisu samo planine, rijeke, doline, zemlja su, prije svega, ljudi. Zemlju ne čine zastave, politički pamfleti, zemlju čine obični ljudi sa svakodnevnim životima, radostima i tugama... O toj i takvoj zemlji govori novi serijal Informativnog programa BHT1, "Moja zemlja", koji uređuje i, vozeći svoj oldtimer obilazi s kraja na kraj čudesne Bosne i Hercegovine, vodi Elvir Bucalo.

He discovered that German settlers left his mark in Millwaukee, and how Christopher Latham Sholes created the QWERTY system, which is used on the homes and modern keyboards. At the end of the trip comes to the Federal State of Illinois and its capital Chicago, where it reveals that the first skyscraper was created. / U ovom dijelu putovanja Michael Portillo dolazi do obala jezera Michigan. Posjetio je fabriku čuvenih motocikala Harly-Davidson. Otkrio je kako su njemački doseljenici ostavili svoj trag u Millwaukeeju, te kako je Christopher Latham Sholes kreirao sistem QWERTY, koji se koristi na mašinama za kucanje i modernim tastaturama. Na kraju putovanja dolazi u saveznu državu Illinois i njen glavni grad Chicago, gdje otkriva da je tu nastao prvi neboder.

programme.desc: This is a story of murder, plot, blood and secrets, but above all for love - an impossible love between two young, Aurora Taviani and Alessandro Montfort. The onion killer and the relationship between the hostile families - Taviani and Montfort. The effect develops amid the great vineyards of the picturesque province of Tuscany. / Това е една история за убийство, заговор, кръв и тайни, но преди всичко за любов - една невъзможна любов между двама млади, Аурора Тавиани и Алесандро Монфорте.Аурора Тавиани, несправедливо обвинена в убийството на Лука Монфорте, е освободена от затвора след 8-годишна присъда и се прибира в къщата на баба си.... programme.title: Football: World Cup qualifiers 2026: Oman - Qatar / Футбол: Квалификации за Световно първенство 2026: Оман - Катар
programme.desc: National teams from different continents compete in groups and playoffs to win a place among the best to fight for the world title. The qualifications are divided into Confederations - Europe (UEFA), South America (CONMEBOL), Asia (AFC), Africa (Kaf), North and Central America (Konkacaf) and Oceania (OFK). Each region has its own format, with matches being held for several years. / Националните отбори от различни континенти се състезават в групи и плейофи, за да спечелят място сред най-добрите, които ще се борят за световната титла. Квалификациите са разделени по конфедерации – Европа (УЕФА), Южна Америка (КОНМЕБОЛ), Азия (АФК), Африка (КАФ), Северна и Централна Америка (КОНКАКАФ) и Океания (ОФК). Всеки регион има свой формат, като мачовете се провеждат в продължение на няколко години.

programme.title: Basketball: Spain Super Cup: semifinal: Unique - Valencia / Баскетбол: Суперкупа на Испания: Полуфинал: Уникаха - Валенсия
programme.desc: The Super Cup of Spain is an annual basketball tournament that opens the season in the country. It features the ACB League Champion, the King's Cup winner, the current Super Cup winner and another team, usually the host or a high -rated team. The tournament is held in the Final Four format with semi -finals and the final within a weekend. It offers fans the first derbies between leading Spanish clubs such as Real Madrid, Barcelona and Valencia and serves as a prelude to the new season. / Суперкупата на Испания е ежегоден баскетболен турнир, който открива сезона в страната. В него участват шампионът на Лига ACB, носителят на Купата на краля, настоящият победител в Суперкупата и още един отбор, обикновено домакинът или тим с висок рейтинг. Турнирът се провежда по формат "финална четворка" с полуфинали и финал в рамките на един уикенд. Той предлага на феновете първите дербита между водещите испански клубове като Реал Мадрид, Барселона и Валенсия и служи като прелюдия към новия сезон.

programme.title: The Promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E41, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E41, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. programme.title: AGATHE CHRISTIE TRAVELS WITH SIR David Suchet / Putovanja Agathe Christie sa Sir Davidom Suchetom
programme.desc: Travels with Agatha Christie and Sir David Suchet - (E02, Tourism Program, England, 2025) In 1922, long before she became the best -selling author in the world, Agatha Christie embarked on an exciting world trip. Now, 100 years later, Sir David Suchet, who played Poirota, goes in her footsteps. On her incredible adventure, Agatha traveled through the then British Empire and visited South Africa, Australia, New Zealand and Canada, and spent a vacation in Hawaii. Armed with her trusted camera that will perpetuate her travels, Sir David will watch what she saw, what will give him insight into how that journey influenced her life and her literary work and will discover the unknown sides of her character. The way people understand Agath Christie is usually overshadowed by her public person she held in later life, when they considered her shy and withdrawn. But it was only a defensive wall that Agatha raised around her, and Sir David will discover her completely different character on her journey: a curious and carefree young woman who seems to become more and more self -conscious and more independent. In 1922, Agatha was only 31 years old and just started her literary journey. But by the time she returned home, they declared her one of the brightest young talents of the time. Agath's global journey happened because she and her husband Archie were part of a special mission in charge of promoting the upcoming exhibition of the British Empire. Held in London in 1924, designed to encourage the trade and strengthen ties among various nations. In addition to exploring Agath's past, Sir David will deal with the fascinating history of the countries she has visited. She will discover that the situation has changed in a hundred years since her journey and will see that different communities are struggling with complex inheritance of colonialism and how to transform it. R .: Catherine Abbott ... / Travels with Agatha Christie and Sir David Suchet - (E02, turistički program, Engleska, 2025) Godine 1922., mnogo prije nego što je postala najprodavanija autorica na svijetu, Agatha Christie krenula je na uzbudljivo svjetsko putovanje. Sada, 100 godina poslije, sir David Suchet, koji je glumio Poirota, ide njezinim stopama. Na svojoj nevjerojatnoj pustolovini Agatha je putovala kroz tadašnje Britansko Carstvo te je posjetila Južnu Afriku, Australiju, Novi Zeland i Kanadu, a provela je i odmor na Havajima. Naoružan svojim pouzdanim fotoaparatom kojim će ovjekovječiti svoja putovanja, sir David će gledati ono što je ona vidjela, što će mu pružiti uvid u to kako je to putovanje utjecalo na njezin život i njezin književni rad te će otkriti nepoznate strane njezina karaktera. Način na koji ljudi poimaju Agathu Christie obično je zasjenjen njezinom javnom osobom koju je održavala u kasnijem životu, kada su je smatrali sramežljivom i povučenom. No to je bio tek obrambeni zid koji je Agatha podigla oko sebe, a sir David će na svojem putovanju otkriti njezin sasvim drukčiji lik: znatiželjnu i bezbrižnu mladu ženu koja je, čini se, postajala sve samosvjesnija i neovisnija. Godine 1922. Agatha je imala samo 31 godinu i tek je počinjala svoje književno putovanje. No, do trenutka kada se vratila kući, proglasili su je jednim od najsjajnijih mladih talenata toga doba. Agathino globalno putovanje dogodilo se jer su ona i njezin suprug Archie bili dio posebne misije zadužene za promicanje nadolazeće Izložbe Britanskog Carstva. Održana u Londonu 1924. godine, osmišljena je kako bi potaknula trgovinu i ojačala veze među raznim narodima. Osim što će istražiti Agathinu prošlost, sir David će se baviti fascinantnom poviješću zemalja koje je posjetila. Otkrit će kako se situacija promijenila u sto godina od njezina putovanja i vidjet će kako se različite zajednice bore sa složenim nasljeđem kolonijalizma te kako ga transformiraju. R.: Catherine Abbott...

programme.title: The Promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E42, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Provece owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E42, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. programme.title: The Promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E43, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Provece owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E43, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. programme.desc: Exploring India with Bettany Hughes - (E02, Nature. Film, England, 2023) The exceptional capital of the Vijayanagar Empire from the 14th century covers the ruins of palaces, temples, forts, shrines, halls with colonna, water channels, guardians, checkpoints and special streets. In this Hindu center of Rama, Rama allegedly met Hanuman for the first time, and the largest monolithic statue of the divinity of Elephant Ganesha was kept. Thanjavur, also known as the Tanjore, became the capital of the Chola Empire, one of the longest -running dynasties in the history of the world in the 8th century. Bettany travels to the heart of the city to reveal an incredible story of these powerful rulers. He explores the Bihadeeswarar Braci Temple from 10th century, and then travels to the nearby town of Swamamalalai, where he discovers divine statues that literally pop out of the mold. Together with the Himalayan rail of Darjeeling and the rail between Kalka and Shimle, the Nilgiri mountain railway is an extraordinary example of an innovative transportation system on uneven and challenging terrain. Bettany enjoys a amazing journey between Mettupalayama and Udhagamandal, a pleasant ride across the Tamil Nadu hill. Arriving at the final destination high in the mountains, he meets a unique people of Toda, who still celebrates the arrival of the train, which has forever changed their way of life. Bettanyno's journey south India takes her to the glittering state of Kerara. There he testifies to the extraordinary dance of Theyattam, typical of this region. The holy dancers visit villages and temples, dressed in rich costumes and vividly colored bodies, and embodies gods and goddesses in music scenes that last all night. Bettanyna an adventure on the Malabar coast ends on one of the famous housing ships. Sailing the channels, she explores the ancient trade of spices that shaped the landscape and the history of India. Freya Tumpert (Bettany Hughes), Uta Delbridge (Dr. M. Bavani), Frank Jordan (Mukund Padmanabhan), Katharina von Keller (Tanya Abraham), Heiner Kock (Arjuhn Bhat) ... / Exploring India with Bettany Hughes - (E02, prirod. film, Engleska, 2023) Iznimna prijestolnica Carstva Vijayanagara iz 14. stoljeća obuhvaća ruševine palača, hramova, utvrda, svetišta, dvorane s kolonadama, vodene kanale, stražarnice, kontrolne točke i posebne ulice za kočije. U ovom hinduističkom središtu Rama je navodno prvi put susreo Hanumana, a čuva se i najveći monolitni kip božanstva slona Ganesha. Thanjavur, također poznat kao Tanjore, u 8. je stoljeću postao prijestolnica Carstva Chola, jedne od najdugovječnijih dinastija u povijesti svijeta. Bettany putuje u srce grada kako bi otkrila nevjerojatnu priču o ovim moćnim vladarima. Istražuje hram Brihadeeswarar iz 10. stoljeća, a zatim putuje u obližnji gradić Swamimalai, gdje otkriva božanske kipove koji doslovno iskaču iz kalupa. Zajedno s Himalajskom željeznicom Darjeeling i željeznicom između Kalke i Shimle, planinska željeznica Nilgiri izvanredan je primjer inovativnog sustava prijevoza na neravnu i izazovnu terenu. Bettany uživa u zadivljujućem putovanju između Mettupalayama i Udhagamandalama, ugodnoj vožnji preko brežuljaka Tamil Nadua. Stigavši na konačno odredište visoko u planinama, susreće jedinstveni narod Toda, koji još uvijek slavi dolazak vlaka što je zauvijek promijenio njihov način života. Bettanyno putovanje južnom Indijom vodi je u blistavu državu Kerala. Ondje svjedoči izvanrednom plesu theyattam, tipičnom za ovu regiju. Sveti plesači obilaze sela i hramove, odjeveni u bogate kostime i živopisno obojenih tijela, te utjelovljuju bogove i boginje u glazbenim prizorima koji traju cijelu noć. Bettanyna avantura na Malabarskoj obali završava na jednom od poznatih brodova za stanovanje. Ploveći kanalima ona istražuje drevnu trgovinu začinima koja je oblikovala krajolik i povijest Indije. programme.desc: Exploring India with Bettany Hughes - (e01, nature. Film, England, 2023) Bettanyo journey begins in one of the most tallers of subcontinents - Varanasia. Hindus believes that death in Varanasia and cremation on the banks of the Ganges river allows the cycle of re-birth to interrupt, and salvation achieves. Fatehpur Skri is conceived as an imperial capital of the Mogulski Carkarkar. His new city was bigger than London, but he was inhabited only 14 years. Bettany explores his empty palaces, temples and private pavilions - at the same time revealing a unique worldview of the man who built them. Bettany goes around the Udaipur Palace. He goes to the boat to the Lake Palace, an extraordinary royal residence located on the island in the shining Lake Pichola. The amazing palace is decorated with massive marble slabs with inserted rubs, onyx, jade and carnello - which allegedly served as inspiration for decorations within that mahala. The legendary treasure and monument of love, Taj Mahal, was built in 1632. As a tomb for a favorite woman of the Mogulski Emperor Shah Restrained, Mumtaz Mahal. Bettany goes out in front of a bright white marble building to reveal the intriguing secret - how they are neglected and oversized by the world-famous mausoleum once a refuge of love and loss. In the city of Amritsar, the amazing beautiful temple creates an illusion to hover at the center of St. Lake. Gurudwara is the latest pilgrimage place for Sikhe, but the temple is open for pilgrims of all faiths and offers food to each visitors from the largest free kitchen in the world. Ul.: Freya Trampert (Bettany Hughes), Uta Delbridge (Rana Saffi), Frank Jordan, Katharina von Keller (Anchal Sachan), Heiner Kock (Tarundeep Singh) ... / Exploring India with Bettany Hughes - (E01, prirod. film, Engleska, 2023) Bettanyno putovanje počinje u jednom od najsvetijih gradova potkontinenta - Varanasiju. Hindusi vjeruju da smrt u Varanasiju i kremiranje na obalama rijeke Ganges omogućuje da se ciklus ponovnog rađanja prekine, a spasenje ostvari. Fatehpur Sikri zamišljen je kao carska prijestolnica mogulskog cara Akbara. Njegov novi grad bio je veći od Londona, no bio je naseljen samo 14 godina. Bettany istražuje njegove prazne palače, hramove i privatne paviljone - istovremeno otkrivajući jedinstven svjetonazor čovjeka koji ih je izgradio. Bettany obilazi palače Udaipura. Odlazi čamcem do Jezerske palače, izvanredne kraljevske rezidencije smještene na otoku u blistavom jezeru Pichola. Zadivljujuća palača ukrašena je masivnim mramornim pločama s umetnutim rubinima, oniksom, žadom i karneolom - koji su navodno poslužili kao inspiracija za ukrase unutar Taj Mahala. Legendarno blago i spomenik ljubavi, Taj Mahal, izgrađen je je 1632. godine kao grobnica za omiljenu ženu mogulskog cara Shah Jahana, Mumtaz Mahal. Bettany izlazi ispred građevine od blistavo bijelog mramora kako bi otkrila intrigantnu tajnu - kako su zapušteni i zarasli vrtovi koji okružuju svjetski poznati mauzolej nekoć bili utočišta ljubavi i gubitka. U gradu Amritsar zadivljujuće lijepi hram stvara iluziju da lebdi u središtu svetog jezera. Gurudwara je najsvetije hodočasničko mjesto za Sikhe, no hram je otvoren za hodočasnike svih vjera i nudi hranu svakom posjetitelju iz najveće besplatne kuhinje na svijetu. programme.title: AGATHE CHRISTIE TRAVELS WITH SIR David Suchet / Putovanja Agathe Christie sa Sir Davidom Suchetom
programme.desc: Travels with Agatha Christie and Sir David Suchet - (E02, Tourism Program, England, 2025) In 1922, long before she became the best -selling author in the world, Agatha Christie embarked on an exciting world trip. Now, 100 years later, Sir David Suchet, who played Poirota, goes in her footsteps. On her incredible adventure, Agatha traveled through the then British Empire and visited South Africa, Australia, New Zealand and Canada, and spent a vacation in Hawaii. Armed with her trusted camera that will perpetuate her travels, Sir David will watch what she saw, what will give him insight into how that journey influenced her life and her literary work and will discover the unknown sides of her character. The way people understand Agath Christie is usually overshadowed by her public person she held in later life, when they considered her shy and withdrawn. But it was only a defensive wall that Agatha raised around her, and Sir David will discover her completely different character on her journey: a curious and carefree young woman who seems to become more and more self -conscious and more independent. In 1922, Agatha was only 31 years old and just started her literary journey. But by the time she returned home, they declared her one of the brightest young talents of the time. Agath's global journey happened because she and her husband Archie were part of a special mission in charge of promoting the upcoming exhibition of the British Empire. Held in London in 1924, designed to encourage the trade and strengthen ties among various nations. In addition to exploring Agath's past, Sir David will deal with the fascinating history of the countries she has visited. She will discover that the situation has changed in a hundred years since her journey and will see that different communities are struggling with complex inheritance of colonialism and how to transform it. R .: Catherine Abbott ... / Travels with Agatha Christie and Sir David Suchet - (E02, turistički program, Engleska, 2025) Godine 1922., mnogo prije nego što je postala najprodavanija autorica na svijetu, Agatha Christie krenula je na uzbudljivo svjetsko putovanje. Sada, 100 godina poslije, sir David Suchet, koji je glumio Poirota, ide njezinim stopama. Na svojoj nevjerojatnoj pustolovini Agatha je putovala kroz tadašnje Britansko Carstvo te je posjetila Južnu Afriku, Australiju, Novi Zeland i Kanadu, a provela je i odmor na Havajima. Naoružan svojim pouzdanim fotoaparatom kojim će ovjekovječiti svoja putovanja, sir David će gledati ono što je ona vidjela, što će mu pružiti uvid u to kako je to putovanje utjecalo na njezin život i njezin književni rad te će otkriti nepoznate strane njezina karaktera. Način na koji ljudi poimaju Agathu Christie obično je zasjenjen njezinom javnom osobom koju je održavala u kasnijem životu, kada su je smatrali sramežljivom i povučenom. No to je bio tek obrambeni zid koji je Agatha podigla oko sebe, a sir David će na svojem putovanju otkriti njezin sasvim drukčiji lik: znatiželjnu i bezbrižnu mladu ženu koja je, čini se, postajala sve samosvjesnija i neovisnija. Godine 1922. Agatha je imala samo 31 godinu i tek je počinjala svoje književno putovanje. No, do trenutka kada se vratila kući, proglasili su je jednim od najsjajnijih mladih talenata toga doba. Agathino globalno putovanje dogodilo se jer su ona i njezin suprug Archie bili dio posebne misije zadužene za promicanje nadolazeće Izložbe Britanskog Carstva. Održana u Londonu 1924. godine, osmišljena je kako bi potaknula trgovinu i ojačala veze među raznim narodima. Osim što će istražiti Agathinu prošlost, sir David će se baviti fascinantnom poviješću zemalja koje je posjetila. Otkrit će kako se situacija promijenila u sto godina od njezina putovanja i vidjet će kako se različite zajednice bore sa složenim nasljeđem kolonijalizma te kako ga transformiraju. R.: Catherine Abbott...

programme.title: A silent rogue / Tihi skitnica
programme.desc: Silent rogue - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2023) The story of Virgili Bride, one of the greatest Croatian graphic artist painters. He was born in the village of Kolo near Tomislavgrad. After completing his studies of fine arts in Zagreb, in 1967 he moved to Paris, where he acted until his death in 2009. It is an artist who has declared French art criticism one of the largest graphics of the 20th century. He left behind a great artistic oeuvre and thousands of pages of a personal diary that led to death. His works are exhibited in all relevant world museums - from France, Japan, Belgium, the United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, across the US and Canada. Virgilia Brides made hundreds of oils, drawings, pastel, ceramics and more than 10,000 graphics plates in his life. He is the author of several collections of poetry. He was friends with great literary sizes and Nobel ladies such as Pablo Neruda, Ezra Pound, Samuel Beckett, Andrea de Richaud, Dragutin Tadijanovic, Zlatko Tomicic, Zvonimir Balog, Pierra Seghers. He also worked for them large graphic folders. R.: Zdenko Jurilj ... / Tihi skitnica - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2023) Priča o Virgiliju Nevjestiću, jednom od najvećih hrvatskih slikara grafičara. Rođen je u selu Kolo kod Tomislavgrada. Nakon završetka studija likovne umjetnosti u Zagrebu, 1967. seli se u Pariz, gdje djeluje do svoje smrti 2009. godine. Radi se o umjetniku kojeg je francuska likovna kritika proglasila jednim od najvećih grafičara 20. stoljeća. Iza sebe je ostavio veliki umjetnički opus i na tisuće stranica osobnog dnevnika koji je vodio do smrti. Njegova djela su izložena u svim relevantnim svjetskim muzejima - od Francuske, Japana, Belgije, Velike Britanije, Njemačke, Švicarske, preko SAD-a i Kanade. Virgilije Nevjestić je za života napravio na stotine ulja, crteža, pastela, keramike i više od 10.000 grafičkih ploča. Autor je nekoliko zbirki poezije. Prijateljevao je s velikim književnim veličinama i nobelovcima poput Pabla Nerude, Ezre Pounda, Samuela Becketta, Andrea de Richauda, Dragutina Tadijanovića, Zlatka Tomičića, Zvonimir Baloga, Pierra Seghersa. Za njih je također radio i velike grafičke mape. R.: Zdenko Jurilj...

Neki ostavljaju djetinjstvo iza sebe u potrazi za prvim poljupcem, drugi pak muku muče s odgojem tinejdžera ili se, suočeni sa starenjem, prisjećaju mladenačkih strasti - obitelj Goldberg iskusit će sve to. I u dobru i u zlu, oni su uvijek tu jedni za druge. programme.title: Patina Mexican dishes / Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: Patis Mexican Table - (S12, E05, Educational Program, USA, 2023) The head of Pati Jinich again goes to the Mexican federal state of Yucatán, once the center of the Mayan civilization, and explores the influence of this ancient people on its cultural and culinary heritage. The remains of the Mayan culture are still ubiquitous in everyday life, so it suffers to travel to the state to meet chefs, craftsmen and families who keep and continue that tradition. programme.desc: Endeavour - (S07, E03, feature series, England, 2020) The excellent British crime series Endeavour brings us back to the past of one of the unforgettable television characters and reveals to us that the career of later famous inspector Morse. Shaun Evans Young is Detective Endeavour Morse! The heir to John Thaw Shaun Evans (robbery, Come Rain Come Shine) plays the younger version of the famous Colin Dexter character and allows viewers to learn more about the past of the famed detective in love for crossword puzzles, classic music, English beer and classic cars. The story is located in 1965 and follows the search for a missing student for which Endeavour Morse returns to the city that will eventually shape and determine his fate - Oxford. In the midst of a complicated murder investigation, led by Inspector Fred Thursday (Roger Allam), Endeavour becomes marginalized, discredited and small. Faced with demons from his past, he embarks on his struggle for justice, risking everything in search of the truth that will persecute him for the rest of his life. R .: Kate Saxon Ul.: Shaun Evans (DS Endeavour Morse), Roger Allam (DCI Fred Thursday), Sean Rigby (DS Jim Stanges), James Bradshaw (Dr. Max Debryn), Anton Lesser (ACC Reginald Bright) ... / Endeavour - (S07, E03, igrana serija, Engleska, 2020) Izvrsna britanska kriminalistička serija Endeavour vraća nas u prošlost jednog od nezaboravnih televizijskih likova i razotkriva nam kako je počela karijera kasnije slavnog inspektora Morsea. Shaun Evans mladi je detektiv Endeavour Morse! Nasljednik Johna Thawa Shaun Evans (Pljačka, Come Rain Come Shine) glumi mlađu verziju slavnog lika Colina Dextera i omogućava gledateljima da saznaju više o prošlosti detektiva slavnog po ljubavi prema križaljkama, klasičnoj glazbi, engleskom pivu i klasičnim automobilima. Priča je smještena u 1965. godinu i prati potragu za nestalom učenicom zbog koje se Endeavour Morse vraća u grad koji će na kraju oblikovati i odrediti njegovu sudbinu - Oxford. Usred komplicirane istrage ubojstva koju vodi inspektor Fred Thursday (Roger Allam), Endeavour postaje marginaliziran, diskreditiran i malodušan. Suočen s demonima iz svoje prošlosti kreće u svoju borbu za pravdu, riskirajući sve u potrazi za istinom koja će ga progoniti do kraja života. R.: Kate Saxon Ul.: Shaun Evans (DS Endeavour Morse), Roger Allam (DCI Fred Thursday), Sean Rigby (DS Jim Strange), James Bradshaw (Dr. Max DeBryn), Anton Lesser (ACC Reginald Bright)...

programme.title: In India with Bettany Hughes / U Indiji s Bettany Hughes
programme.desc: Exploring India with Bettany Hughes - (E02, Nature. Film, England, 2023) The exceptional capital of the Vijayanagar Empire from the 14th century covers the ruins of palaces, temples, forts, shrines, halls with colonna, water channels, guardians, checkpoints and special streets. In this Hindu center of Rama, Rama allegedly met Hanuman for the first time, and the largest monolithic statue of the divinity of Elephant Ganesha was kept. Thanjavur, also known as the Tanjore, became the capital of the Chola Empire, one of the longest -running dynasties in the history of the world in the 8th century. Bettany travels to the heart of the city to reveal an incredible story of these powerful rulers. He explores the Bihadeeswarar Braci Temple from 10th century, and then travels to the nearby town of Swamamalalai, where he discovers divine statues that literally pop out of the mold. Together with the Himalayan rail of Darjeeling and the rail between Kalka and Shimle, the Nilgiri mountain railway is an extraordinary example of an innovative transportation system on uneven and challenging terrain. Bettany enjoys a amazing journey between Mettupalayama and Udhagamandal, a pleasant ride across the Tamil Nadu hill. Arriving at the final destination high in the mountains, he meets a unique people of Toda, who still celebrates the arrival of the train, which has forever changed their way of life. Bettanyno's journey south India takes her to the glittering state of Kerara. There he testifies to the extraordinary dance of Theyattam, typical of this region. The holy dancers visit villages and temples, dressed in rich costumes and vividly colored bodies, and embodies gods and goddesses in music scenes that last all night. Bettanyna an adventure on the Malabar coast ends on one of the famous housing ships. Sailing the channels, she explores the ancient trade of spices that shaped the landscape and the history of India. Freya Tumpert (Bettany Hughes), Uta Delbridge (Dr. M. programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) As Cuba has marked American culture in its entirety, Cuban music has been registered with jazz history since his early days. Today, the Afrokuban jazz is one of his great genres and one of the two pillars of the music continent named Latin Jazz, and the pianist Gonzalo Rubalcab is among his leading representatives, but also the most famous jazz-pivnists in general. He began to show the unusual tendency of Rubalcab music at the youngest age, so as a six -year -old he played drums in the orchestra of Father Guillermo. Zarana labeled as a miracle of a child, Rubalcabs will attract the attention of one of the greatest popularizers of the Afrokububan jazz and jazz icon - Dizzy Gillespie in the mid -1980s, which will invite him to play with him. Shortly thereafter, another key encounter will happen - the one with the Conscious Charlie Haden, who will significantly mark Rubalcab's musical path. Since then, Rubalcaba will achieve a glittering record and concert career, with a number of notable release from Cuban and the wider tradition of jazz such as "Nocturni" and "Land of the Sun" album. The last major recognition of Rubalcabi arrived for the album "Skyline" from 2021, which he recorded with two jazz greats Jack Dejohnette and Ron Carter. It is accompanied by an excellent "Turning Point/Trio Dete", which was joined by a great Matt Brewer and Eric Harland. In addition to Ernest Simpson as a replacement for Harland on drums, Rubalcaba presented his impressive music in early July and at a small Roman theater in Pula ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Kao što je Kuba obilježila američku kulturu u cijelosti, kubanska glazba upisana je u povijest jazza od njegovih ranih dana. Danas je afrokubanski jazz jedan od njegovih velikih žanrova i jedan od dva stupa glazbenog kontinenta po imenu Latin jazz, a pijanist Gonzalo Rubalcaba među njegovim je vodećim predstavnicima, ali i najpoznatijim jazz-pijanistima općenito. Neobičnu sklonost glazbi Rubalcaba je počeo pokazivati u najmlađoj dobi, pa je već kao šestogodišnjak zasvirao bubnjeve u orkestru oca Guillerma. Zarana označen kao čudo od djeteta, Rubalcaba će sredinom osamdesetih u Havani privući pažnju jednog od najvećih popularizatora afrokubanskog jazza i ikone jazza - Dizzyja Gillespieja, koji će ga pozvati da s njim zasvira. Ubrzo nakon toga dogodit će se još jedan ključan susret - onaj s konstrabasistom Charliejem Hadenom, koji će bitno obilježiti Rubalcabin glazbeni put. Otad će Rubalcaba ostvariti blistavu diskografsku i koncertnu karijeru, uz niz zapaženih izdanja izniklih iz kubanske, ali i šire tradicije jazza poput albuma "Nocturne" i "Land of the Sun". Posljednje veliko priznanje Rubalcabi je stiglo za album "Skyline" iz 2021., koji je snimio s dvama velikanima jazza Jackom DeJohnetteom i Ronom Carterom. Na njega se nadovezuje izvrsni "Turning Point/Trio Dete", na kojem su mu se pridružili sjajni Matt Brewer i Eric Harland. Uz Ernesta Simpsona kao zamjenu za Harlanda na bubnjevima, Rubalcaba je svoju impresivnu glazbu predstavio početkom srpnja i u Malom rimskom kazalištu u Puli...

programme.title: Monika Leskovar and HRT Symphony Orchestra under the direction of Pascal Rophea - KD V. Lisinski / Monika Leskovar i Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a pod ravnanjem Pascala Rophea - KD V. Lisinski
programme.desc: Monika Leskovar and HRT Symphony Orchestra under the direction of Pascal Rophea - KD V. Lisinski - (film Class. Music, Croatia, 2025) The HRT Symphony Orchestra opens the new season of the master cycle under the guidance of Maestro Pascal Rophe, which begins its second term of the chief of the Dirigent orchestra. The program begins with the Singing Song of Slava (Chant du Rossignol) Igor Stravinsky, derived from his opera Slavuj (1914). Stravinski's contemporary and countryman Sergei Rahmanjin's second symphony returned his faith in a composer call after a catastrophic failure of the first symphony of 1897 and the severe creative crisis that followed. Another symphony, intended for the large composition of the symphony orchestra, with as many as three instruments each in most width sections and an extended group of percussion, contains an abundance of beautiful, swollen romantic music, but at the same time a masterfully controlled tension that is released in the magnificent final. The concert soloist is one of our most awarded cellist, Monika Leskovar, who, as a thirteen -year -old, became the youngest winner of the International Tchaikovsky Competition in Japan (1995). Rich in international careers, today he teaches at the Academy of Music in Zagreb and always gladly returns to the HRT Symphony Orchestra, and on this occasion in the interpretation of the variation on the Rokoko Theme of Petra Iljic Tchaikovsky. Although his role model were classic forms and type of orchestra from Hayn's time, Petar Iljic Tchaikovsky created more than a virtuosic and romantic gorgeous work with a prose rococo theme and complex variations in his variations. Lisinski - (film klas. glazbe, Hrvatska, 2025) Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a otvara novu sezonu Majstorskog ciklusa pod vodstvom maestra Pascala Rophea koji ovim koncertom počinje svoj drugi mandat šefa dirigenta cijenjenog orkestra. Program počinje simfonijskom pjesmom Pjev slavuja (Chant du rossignol) Igora Stravinskog, proizašlom iz njegove opere Slavuj (1914.). Stravinskijev suvremenik i zemljak Sergej Rahmanjinov Drugom simfonijom vratio je svoju vjeru u skladateljski poziv nakon katastrofalnog neuspjeha Prve simfonije 1897. i teške stvaralačke krize koja je uslijedila. Druga simfonija, namijenjena velikom sastavu simfonijskog orkestra, s čak po tri instrumenta u većini puhačkih sekcija i proširenom skupinom udaraljki, sadrži obilje predivne, nabujale romantičarske glazbe, ali i istovremeno majstorski kontroliranu napetost koja se oslobađa u veličanstvenom finalu. Solistica na koncertu je jedna od naših najnagrađivanijih violončelistica, Monika Leskovar, koja je kao trinaestogodišnjakinja postala najmlađa pobjednica Međunarodnog natjecanja Čajkovski u Japanu (1995.). Bogate međunarodne karijere, danas predaje na Muzičkoj akademiji u Zagrebu te se uvijek rado vraća pred Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a, a ovom prigodom u interpretaciji Varijacija na rokoko temu Petra Iljiča Čajkovskog. Iako su mu uzor bile klasične forme i tip orkestra iz Haydnova doba, Petar Iljič Čajkovski u svojim je Varijacijama stvorio više nego virtuozno i romantičarski raskošno djelo s prpošnom rokoko temom i kompleksnim varijacijama. Inteligentno pisana, subverzivno humoristična i simpatično duhovita, serija ismijava okolinu, ali i samu sebe. Dobitnica je brojnih nagrada. Simpsoni su uz to trenutačni vlasnici dva Guinnesova rekorda i to kao najdulje emitirana animirana serija i serija s najviše ugošćenih zvijezda. Obitelj Simpson čine: otac Homer, koji radi kao inspektor zaštite na radu u mjesnoj nuklearnoj elektrani, majka Marge, koja pokušava zadržati mir u obitelji, nestašni desetogodišnjak Bart, inteligentna saksofonistica osmogodišnja Lisa i najmanja Maggie, koja emocije izražava dudanjem. Gledatelji su s vremenom upoznali i zavoljeli preostali bogati i nerijetko neobični svijet likova koji žive u Springfieldu.Simpsoni, koje je osmislio animator Matt Groening, prvi su se put pojavili 1987. kao serija kratkih priča u 30 sekunda koje je Groening producirao za The Tracy Ullman Show. Uskoro su dobili vlastitu seriju emitiravši se prvi put u božićnom specijalu 17. prosinca 1989., a zatim i u redovnom terminu 14. siječnja 1990. Posjeduju svoju zvijezdu na holivudskoj Stazi slavnih, a 1. svibnja 2005. američka najzabavnija obitelj proslavila je tada rekordnu 350. epizodu. R.: Mike B. Anderson Ul.: Dan Castellaneta (Homer Simpson), Julie Kavner (Marge Simpson), Nancy Cartwright (Bart Simpson), Yeardley Smith (Lisa Simpson), Harry Shearer (Ned Flanders)...

Mangiole, who will soon give place to her colleague Leonard Jakovina. But the point is that he started the back of the dance "on the spikes", opening a series of auditions for new dancers. Here we get to know the old and new stars of the ensemble, these are Marta Voinea Cavrak (half -sister Zorica), Yurik Kimura (Ella/Cinderella), Leonard Cel (John/Prince) and Marta Kanazir (Cindy/Mother), as well as a number of children from Rijeka's dance schools. Zajca Rijeka. Prva baletna premijera u riječkom mandatu intendantice Dubravke Vrgoč vraća u "grad koji teče" omiljenog koreografa Lea Mujića kojemu je ovo četvrta predstava s Riječkim baletom. Želeći naći nešto svima poznato i privlačno, što bi vratilo u Rijeku djecu na scenu i balerine "na špice", odabiru neoklasični balet Sergeja Prokofjeva prema poznatoj priči Charlesa Perraulta - Pepeljugu - praizvedenu na podiju moskovskoga Boljšoj teatra godine 1945. To je prvo predstavljanje novog, a sada već bivšeg ravnatelja Riječkog baleta, Talijana Paola Mangiole, koji će uskoro ustupiti mjesto kolegi Leonardu Jakovini. Ali bit je da je pokrenuo povratak plesa "na špicama" otvorivši niz audicija za nove plesače. Tu upoznajemo stare i nove zvijezde ansambla, to su Marta Voinea Čavrak (polusestra Zorica), Yurika Kimura (Ella/Pepeljuga), Leonard Cela (John/Princ) i Marta Kanazir (Cindy/Majka), ali i niz djece iz riječkih plesnih škola. programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) As Cuba has marked American culture in its entirety, Cuban music has been registered with jazz history since his early days. Today, the Afrokuban jazz is one of his great genres and one of the two pillars of the music continent named Latin Jazz, and the pianist Gonzalo Rubalcab is among his leading representatives, but also the most famous jazz-pivnists in general. He began to show the unusual tendency of Rubalcab music at the youngest age, so as a six -year -old he played drums in the orchestra of Father Guillermo. Zarana labeled as a miracle of a child, Rubalcabs will attract the attention of one of the greatest popularizers of the Afrokububan jazz and jazz icon - Dizzy Gillespie in the mid -1980s, which will invite him to play with him. Shortly thereafter, another key encounter will happen - the one with the Conscious Charlie Haden, who will significantly mark Rubalcab's musical path. Since then, Rubalcaba will achieve a glittering record and concert career, with a number of notable release from Cuban and the wider tradition of jazz such as "Nocturni" and "Land of the Sun" album. The last major recognition of Rubalcabi arrived for the album "Skyline" from 2021, which he recorded with two jazz greats Jack Dejohnette and Ron Carter. It is accompanied by an excellent "Turning Point/Trio Dete", which was joined by a great Matt Brewer and Eric Harland. In addition to Ernest Simpson as a replacement for Harland on drums, Rubalcaba presented his impressive music in early July and at a small Roman theater in Pula ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Kao što je Kuba obilježila američku kulturu u cijelosti, kubanska glazba upisana je u povijest jazza od njegovih ranih dana. Danas je afrokubanski jazz jedan od njegovih velikih žanrova i jedan od dva stupa glazbenog kontinenta po imenu Latin jazz, a pijanist Gonzalo Rubalcaba među njegovim je vodećim predstavnicima, ali i najpoznatijim jazz-pijanistima općenito. Neobičnu sklonost glazbi Rubalcaba je počeo pokazivati u najmlađoj dobi, pa je već kao šestogodišnjak zasvirao bubnjeve u orkestru oca Guillerma. Zarana označen kao čudo od djeteta, Rubalcaba će sredinom osamdesetih u Havani privući pažnju jednog od najvećih popularizatora afrokubanskog jazza i ikone jazza - Dizzyja Gillespieja, koji će ga pozvati da s njim zasvira. Ubrzo nakon toga dogodit će se još jedan ključan susret - onaj s konstrabasistom Charliejem Hadenom, koji će bitno obilježiti Rubalcabin glazbeni put. Otad će Rubalcaba ostvariti blistavu diskografsku i koncertnu karijeru, uz niz zapaženih izdanja izniklih iz kubanske, ali i šire tradicije jazza poput albuma "Nocturne" i "Land of the Sun". Posljednje veliko priznanje Rubalcabi je stiglo za album "Skyline" iz 2021., koji je snimio s dvama velikanima jazza Jackom DeJohnetteom i Ronom Carterom. Na njega se nadovezuje izvrsni "Turning Point/Trio Dete", na kojem su mu se pridružili sjajni Matt Brewer i Eric Harland. Uz Ernesta Simpsona kao zamjenu za Harlanda na bubnjevima, Rubalcaba je svoju impresivnu glazbu predstavio početkom srpnja i u Malom rimskom kazalištu u Puli...

programme.title: Talking to the rocks / Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: Talking to Rocks - (E01, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2024) In the first episode, we head to geological sides with the beautiful Slavonian Mount Papuk. With the help of scientists, our professional guides, we get to know the exceptional geological, biological and cultural and historical heritage of this mountain. What at first glance was just a piece of rock will suddenly bring us back to the Cambria period, 450 million years back, to a global event of a sudden development of life. Following the clues, we climb the time ladder and travel for millions of years of geological past. From the rest of the ancient volcanoes, through strong tectonic movements, to traces of the Pannonian Sea. Along the way we meet the famous Charug, we also visit the Geo-Info Center in Voćin through a sensational virtual walk through the geological wealth of this area. In the House of Pannonian Sea in the Great, in the attractive lineup, we also meet Carcharodon Megalodon, a twenty -meter shark that swam in the former Pannonian Sea. And so step by step, millions of years long, in the youngest tufa deposits we will see the nose of the benign Diva Regoc. Finally, we will rest at one of the most beautiful natural spaces of Papuk, in the Gorski Kotar Valley Jankovac. R .: Lada Džidić Barić ... / Razgovor sa stijenama - (E01, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2024) U prvoj epizodi krećemo na geološke skitnje predivnom slavonskom planinom Papuk. Uz pomoć znanstvenika, naših stručnih vodiča, upoznajemo iznimnu geološku, biološku i kulturno-povijesnu baštinu ove planine. Ono što nam je na prvi pogled bio tek komad stijene odjednom će nas vratiti u razdoblje kambrija, 450 milijuna godina unatrag, u globalni događaj naglog razvoja života. Slijedeći tragove penjemo se vremenskom ljestvicom i putujemo milijunima godina geološke prošlosti. Od ostatka drevnih vulkana, preko snažnih tektonskih pokreta, do tragova Panonskoga mora. Na putu susrećemo i znamenitog Čarugu, posjećujemo i Geo-info centar u Voćinu kroz senzacionalnu virtualnu šetnju geološkim bogatstvom ovoga kraja. U Kući Panonskoga mora u Velikoj, u atraktivnom postavu susrećemo i carcharodon megalodona, dvadesetmetarskoga morskoga psa koji je plivao u nekadašnjem Panonskom moru. I tako korak po korak, dugačak milijune godina, u najmlađim naslagama sedre ugledat ćemo nos dobroćudnoga diva Regoča. Za kraj, odmorit ćemo se na jednom od najljepših prirodnih prostora Papuka, u gorskoj dolini Jankovac. R.: Lada Džidić Barić...

Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. programme.title: Talking to the rocks / Razgovor sa stijenama
programme.desc: Talking to Rocks - (E01, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2024) In the first episode, we head to geological sides with the beautiful Slavonian Mount Papuk. With the help of scientists, our professional guides, we get to know the exceptional geological, biological and cultural and historical heritage of this mountain. What at first glance was just a piece of rock will suddenly bring us back to the Cambria period, 450 million years back, to a global event of a sudden development of life. Following the clues, we climb the time ladder and travel for millions of years of geological past. From the rest of the ancient volcanoes, through strong tectonic movements, to traces of the Pannonian Sea. Along the way we meet the famous Charug, we also visit the Geo-Info Center in Voćin through a sensational virtual walk through the geological wealth of this area. In the House of Pannonian Sea in the Great, in the attractive lineup, we also meet Carcharodon Megalodon, a twenty -meter shark that swam in the former Pannonian Sea. And so step by step, millions of years long, in the youngest tufa deposits we will see the nose of the benign Diva Regoc. Finally, we will rest at one of the most beautiful natural spaces of Papuk, in the Gorski Kotar Valley Jankovac. R .: Lada Džidić Barić ... / Razgovor sa stijenama - (E01, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2024) U prvoj epizodi krećemo na geološke skitnje predivnom slavonskom planinom Papuk. Uz pomoć znanstvenika, naših stručnih vodiča, upoznajemo iznimnu geološku, biološku i kulturno-povijesnu baštinu ove planine. Ono što nam je na prvi pogled bio tek komad stijene odjednom će nas vratiti u razdoblje kambrija, 450 milijuna godina unatrag, u globalni događaj naglog razvoja života. Slijedeći tragove penjemo se vremenskom ljestvicom i putujemo milijunima godina geološke prošlosti. Od ostatka drevnih vulkana, preko snažnih tektonskih pokreta, do tragova Panonskoga mora. Na putu susrećemo i znamenitog Čarugu, posjećujemo i Geo-info centar u Voćinu kroz senzacionalnu virtualnu šetnju geološkim bogatstvom ovoga kraja. U Kući Panonskoga mora u Velikoj, u atraktivnom postavu susrećemo i carcharodon megalodona, dvadesetmetarskoga morskoga psa koji je plivao u nekadašnjem Panonskom moru. I tako korak po korak, dugačak milijune godina, u najmlađim naslagama sedre ugledat ćemo nos dobroćudnoga diva Regoča. Za kraj, odmorit ćemo se na jednom od najljepših prirodnih prostora Papuka, u gorskoj dolini Jankovac. R.: Lada Džidić Barić...

Bernadette je očekivala da će dolaskom u Elizejsku palaču konačno dobiti mjesto koje zaslužuje, jer je svom suprugu uvijek bila potpora i pomogla mu da postane predsjednik, ali prevarila se. programme.title: Lanternist / Lanternist
programme.desc: Lantenist - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2009) Documentary film about going, a lighthouse on Stončica. Ivan Bulić Ićo has been working as a lighthouse since 1995. He changed several lighthous, from Blitvenica to Palagruza. He is currently working on Stončica, a lighthouse located on the east side of Vis. Ićo has one -month shifts, he is a month in Split, where he lives, and a month on the lighthouse. The Stončica is twenty minutes away from Vis by car and a twenty minute walk in a goat path. Sometimes friends from Vis or Split come to him. In his spare time, he closed himself in his little workshop and made fish from wooden charges, which he has shown several times at exhibitions in Split, Vis and Zagreb. The film shows the life of a lighthouse, and through the story of Ivan Bulic it can be seen that loneliness is not conditioned by being alone somewhere. R .: Tanja Kanceljak ... / Lanternist - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2009) Dokumentarni film o Ići, svjetioničaru na Stončici. Ivan Bulić Ićo od 1995. godine radi kao svjetioničar. Promijenio je nekoliko svjetionika, od Blitvenice do Palagruže. Trenutačno radi na Stončici, svjetioniku smještenome na istočnoj strani Visa. Ićo ima jednomjesečne smjene, mjesec dana je u Splitu, gdje živi, a mjesec dana na svjetioniku. Stončica je udaljena od Visa dvadesetak minuta automobilom i još dvadesetak minuta hoda kozjom stazom. Ponekad mu dođu prijatelji iz Visa ili Splita. U slobodno vrijeme zatvori se u svoju malu radionicu i od drvenih naplavina izrađuje ribe koje je već nekoliko puta prikazao na izložbama u Splitu, Visu i Zagrebu. U filmu je prikazan život svjetioničara, a kroz priču o Ivanu Buliću vidi se da samoća nije uvjetovana time da si negdje sam. R.: Tanja Kanceljak...
